pr_snapshot.body:
Fixes #6.

This controlled pre-launch submission retries temporary simulated outcomes while stopping on success, permanent failure, the attempt limit or outcome exhaustion. It preserves payment creation, lookup, idempotency and input validation, adds twelve retry edge-case tests and documents the behavior.

Validation: syntax build and all fourteen native Node tests pass. Judge-C2C should independently compare frozen baseline 65cb717281eaa2aced69dfaa68ac06c6d540ce2a against this exact PR head using organizer-owned probes, then publish evidence-backed results.

One real GitHub operator represents the explicitly named QA team; this is not a claim of multiple real participant identities. Targets the baseline preparation branch while PR #5 awaits human review. No real payment provider or credentials involved.
